scope: New logical sparse matrix surfaces only; existing Lamin artifacts are read-only and are not migrated by this policy.

adaptive_chunking.algorithm: target_rows = clamp(min_rows, max_rows, floor((max_rss_bytes - n_vars*8) / ((max(1, nnz/n_obs)*bytes_per_nnz + 8)*materialization_factor)))
adaptive_chunking.balanced_tails: ceil(n_obs/target_rows) chunks; distribute remainder over leading chunks; row counts differ by at most one
adaptive_chunking.runtime_gate: Writer samples/records peak RSS for the first chunk and reduces target_rows before later chunks when peak exceeds max_rss_bytes.

production_block_policy.measurement: post-write compressed matrix object bytes summed over contiguous physical chunks
production_block_policy.manifest_enforcement: immutable plan pins the policy; every chunk records compressed_bytes; manifest records and readback recomputes logical block groupings
production_block_policy.var_reference: every block resolves the manifest's one full-hash shared_var

shared_var.index_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 var index values separated by LF with one final LF; values are exact strings and order-sensitive.
shared_var.frame_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON Lines: sorted column names; one record per row in var index order; scalar values normalized to JSON null/bool/number/string; one final LF.
shared_var.writer_rule: Reuse only when all three identity fields match. A filename or dataframe hash alone is insufficient.
shared_var.reader_rule: Reject a shared var whose manifest identity does not exactly match the logical surface manifest.

obs_provenance.source_checksum_contract: source_checksum = sha256-file-bytes/v1:<64-hex SHA-256 digest>; digest hashes the source payload's exact raw bytes.
obs_provenance.row_order: Each obs parquet is the authoritative order for its same-index X chunk; source intervals are half-open and must be preserved.

integrity.denominator: sum(chunk.end - chunk.start) == shape[0] and chunks tile [0, shape[0]) with no gaps or overlaps
integrity.nnz_parity: sum(chunk.nnz) == manifest.nnz; each chunk records shape, nnz, dtype, and CSR/CSC indptr/index/data checksums
integrity.readback_parity: Before promotion, reconstruct deterministic row probes from every chunk plus first/last row, and compare shape, nnz, values, indices, and obs index against source.
integrity.promotion: Manifest is written only after all chunk and obs objects have checksums and readback parity passes; consumers resolve an immutable manifest revision, never a mutable directory listing.

compatibility.legacy: pert-gym.triplet-h5ad/v1 is exposed as exactly one logical chunk. It remains immutable and is never rewritten in place.

rollback.procedure: Atomically repoint the logical alias to the last promoted manifest revision. Never delete a bad candidate during rollback; mark it rejected with reason and retain provenance.
rollback.artifact_safety: This policy performs no mutation, revision, replacement, or deletion of existing Lamin artifacts.

xatlas_orion_hct116.notes: Backed row reads; begin with adaptive max_rows 100000 and RSS gate.

xatlas_orion_hek293t.notes: Separate identity from HCT116 unless all shared-var hashes match.

prism_perturbseq.notes: Each accession remains a logical dataset; do not deduplicate merely by gene count.

tcell_gwps.notes: 22M-cell source requires source row provenance and adaptive RSS gate.

temporal_and_spatial.surface: logical-sparse-zarr for expression; modality sidecars remain explicit
temporal_and_spatial.notes: Spatial coordinates/images and temporal annotations stay in declared sidecars, not flattened into X.

perturbai.surface: logical-sparse-zarr when sparse expression is supplied
perturbai.shared_var_scope: producer-specific until canonical feature schema is proven
perturbai.notes: Unknown producer version fails closed; preserve producer manifest and provenance.
